privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.intro: Lemnion processes data of visitors to this website carefully and in a privacy-friendly way. This notice explains what data we process, why and for how long, and what your rights are. We do not use cookies and no Google analytics.
privacy.p_verantwoordelijk: This site is run by Lemnion B.V. Privacy questions: info@lemnion.nl.
privacy.p_data1: For visitor analytics we use Matomo, set up privacy-friendly:
privacy.li_ip: IP addresses are anonymized (last bytes removed)
privacy.li_nopersoons: No personal data (no name, email or location)
privacy.p_data2: The contact form only sends the data you fill in yourself (name, email, phone, message), over a secure connection.
privacy.p_doel: Statistics (visitor numbers, most popular pages) to improve the site; the contact form to answer your question.
privacy.p_bewaring: Raw analytics data: 24 months, then aggregate only. Form data: as long as needed for your question, then deleted.
privacy.p_optout: You can switch off the privacy-friendly visitor analytics here:
privacy.p_rechten: Access, correction, deletion or objection: mail info@lemnion.nl. You will receive a reply within a reasonable time.
